POLICE FORCE.
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 46
Date 21-2-16
February 21st 1916

Sir,
At 7.35 p.m. 20th instant two detectives belonging to
Taoyin Chow's yamen arrested two men named Tsu Vi Hou 朱維漢
and Zee Hai Ding 徐海亭 at the S.N.R.Station, as they were
about to leave for Nanking. A revolver was found on the
person of Tsu Vi Hou. Both the prisoners who are said to be
revolutionary transport officers were taken to the Taoyin's
yamen where they are detained.
Owing to the reports that the rebels here would attempt a
rising on the 22nd or 23rd instant, strict precautions are
being taken by the Chinese Authorities.
Since the arrival of Nyou Tih Sung 鈕鐵生 from Japan
the rebels here are becoming more hopeful regarding the local
situation. They now entertain hopes of being able to start
a successful rising in Shanghai but it is not likely that
anything will be done for some time.
It is reported that Taoyin Chow has received a
communication from the Civil Governor of Kiangsu saying
that the land office will remain under Chow's control.
It is reported that information has been received
in Peking that the troops under General Yang, Military
Governor of Shanghai are not to be relied on. In consequence
of this General Feng Nan Wo 馮南武 who has been in Nanking
for some days trying to induce Chiangchun Sung to go to
Peking will come to Shanghai to investigate matters. The
drilling of the troops here is receiving special attention
in preparation for General Feng's arrival as it is expected
that he will inspect the troops which he comes.
The following is a translation of an extract from
the Deutsche Zeitung fur China dated 19th Feby 1916:-
"THE S.S. CHINA HELD UP.
"The steamer of the newly established America-
Chinese" China Mail Steamship Company s.s. "China" which
left Woosung on Friday morning for America had an
unpleasant experience. The same day about noon she was
held up by a British cruiser and for five hours she was
searched by a party from the warship. Thirty eight men
supposed to be Germans were taken from the ship.
The women were not molested and remained on board.

I. O. REG
第 46 号
日期 1916 年 2 月 21 日

先生：

本月 20 日下午 7 时 35 分，道尹周（Taoyin Chow）衙门的两名侦探在沪宁铁路车站逮捕了两名男子，名为朱維漢（Tsu Vi Hou）和徐海亭（Zee Hai Ding），当时他们正准备前往南京。在朱維漢身上搜出一支左轮手枪。这两名囚犯据称是革命军的运输官员，已被带往道尹衙门并予以拘留。

由于有报告称本地的反叛者企图在本月 22 日或 23 日发动起义，中国当局正在采取严格的预防措施。

自从鈕鐵生（Nyou Tih Sung）从日本抵达以来，本地的反叛者对当地局势变得更加乐观。他们现在寄希望于能在上海发动一次成功的起义，但在一段时间内不太可能有任何行动。

据报道，道尹周已收到江苏民政长的一份函件，称土地局将继续由周控制。

据报道，北京方面收到消息，称上海镇守使杨将军麾下的部队不可靠。因此，冯南武（Feng Nan Wo）将军将前来上海调查此事；冯将军已在南京逗留数日，试图劝说宋春昌（Chiangchun Sung，音译）前往北京。鉴于预计冯将军抵达后将检阅部队，本地部队的操练正受到特别关注，以为其到来做准备。

以下是 1916 年 2 月 19 日《德文新报》（Deutsche Zeitung fur China）摘录的译文：——

“‘中国’号轮船被拦截。

新成立的美中‘中国邮船公司’（China Mail Steamship Company）所属的‘中国’号（S.S. China）轮船于周五上午离开吴淞口前往美国，途中遭遇不快经历。同日中午左右，该船被一艘英国巡洋舰拦截，并由该军舰派出的人员进行了长达五小时的搜查。三十八名疑似德国人的男子被带离该船。

妇女未受骚扰，留在船上。

breach of neutrality which nothing can justify because
the ship was sailing under a neutral flag and her
destination was a neutral port and she was held up
in neutral waters.
Laying aside the desire of a certain English
officer to take revenge on a handful defenceless
Germans there may be also be the desire to frighten
passengers from sailing on ships of neutral
companies".

包括两名医生。这是非常严重的违反中立行为，没有任何理由可以为之辩护，因为该船悬挂的是中立国旗帜，目的地是中立国港口，且是在中立水域被拦截的。

撇开某位英国军官想要对少数手无寸铁的德国人进行报复的念头不谈，此举也可能意在恐吓乘客，使其不敢乘坐中立国公司的船只”。

您顺从的仆人，
